selection_process: Applications will be accepted based on merit and experience.
how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for DCPU Thoothukudi Legal cum Probation Officer Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: https://thoothukudi.nic.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 05-10-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DCPU Thoothukudi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the DCPU Thoothukudi Recruitment 2026 is 05-10-2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Legal cum Probation Officer post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.L. / LLB degree from a recognized university and have completed their education as per the (10 + 2 + 5) or (10 + 2 + 3 + 3) system.

faq.question: Q3. How many years of experience are required for this position?
faq.answer: A minimum of 2 years of relevant experience is required. This experience should be in government/voluntary organizations/NGOs or in legal matters concerning child rights and women and child protection.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Legal cum Probation Officer post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applying to the Legal cum Probation Officer post is 42 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 27,804/- per month for the position of Legal cum Probation Officer.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the DCPU Thoothukudi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. You need to download the application form from the official website, fill it out, and submit it along with required documents to the District Child Protection Unit, Thoothukudi.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection of candidates for the DCPU Thoothukudi Recruitment 2026 will be based on merit and the experience of the applicants.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of the Thoothukudi District: https://thoothukudi.nic.in.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I submit with the application form?
faq.answer: You need to submit self-attested copies of required documents, which typically include a photograph, signature, ID proof, and educational certificates. Refer to the official notification for a complete list.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: As per the information available, there is no application fee mentioned for this recruitment drive by the District Child Protection Unit Thoothukudi.
